key_findings: GWAS in diabetic neuropathy links KCNT2 locus (rs114159097) to neuropathic pain intensity; rare SCN9A (Nav1.7) and OPRM1 variants are enriched in painful neuropathy.
ANK2 and LHX8 are novel associations with irritable nociceptor sensory profile and neuropathic pain respectively.
